{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:EV9D9-TTC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]], an [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]]]]
{{Quote|FIFTH REMINDER: Please return your EV to your MerenData dealer for double your money back. We are also offering a 10,000&ndash;credit reward for information leading to the whereabouts of other EV supervisor droids.|MerenData customer mailing|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Supervisor droids''', also known as '''labor management droids''', '''coordinating droids''',<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> '''operations droids''',<ref name="Hideouts">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref> '''control droids''',<ref name="Freedom">{{WEGCite|story=The Heat of Freedom|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> or '''overseer droids''',<ref name="Rules of Engagement">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> were [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]]s designed to oversee other [[Droid/Legends|droids]], but were also used as [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermasters]], and as [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] to maintain other droids.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide to Droids">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>  One such droid, the [[Terreene Brainiac]] class artificial intelligence known as [[Control (droid)|Control]], was employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to run their [[Imperial mining complex|mobile mining operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]].<ref name="Freedom" />

Some [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droids]] manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] had [[MDF motivator|motivators]] that were actually intended for [[Interrogation droid|torture droids]], which made them sadistic towards their droid underlings.<ref name="TEGtD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> On the droid [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]], supervisor droids were labeled as "'''lazy droids'''".<ref name="SU">{{LivingForce|Broken Orbits: Something Uffel}}</ref> Operations droids were also designed to run functions in a building. [[HC55-903]] was an operations droid that was installed in the systems of [[16AA889 Starfield Road]] to provide for the needs of the residents.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>

The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] used these droids to supply [[Starship/Legends|ships]] by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. They were known to have a "quirky" personality, which allowed [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the New Republic's rival, the [[Galactic Empire]], to place espionage programming within the droids. This happened to one such droid [[T5-G3]], which sent two transmissions from within supply convoys without detection.<ref name="Wanted">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>

Similar to [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]], labor management droids were of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] configuration, with two [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and legs; a head; two [[Photoreceptor/Legends|visual]] and two [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio sensors]] tuned to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] range; a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]], [[AA-1 VerboBrain/Legends|AA-1 VerboBrain]] and [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communication module]]. They also had a [[Logic display sensor|logic dispenser]], which would result in additional quirks in their personality if a minor short was subjected to it.<ref name="Wanted" />
